metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2020 · Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Avatar: The Way of Water
metas.description: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Bullet Train
metas.description: Five assassins aboard a swiftly-moving bullet train find out that their missions have something in common.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2021 · Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2021 · Free Guy
metas.description: When Guy, a bank teller, learns that he is a non-player character in a bloodthirsty, open-world video game, he goes on to become the hero of the story and takes the responsibility of saving the world.

metas.description: Supervillains Harley Quinn, Bloodsport, Peacemaker, and a collection of nutty cons at Belle Reve prison join the super-secret, super-shady Task Force X as they are dropped off at the remote, enemy-infused island of Corto Maltese.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2021 · Nobody
metas.description: A docile family man slowly reveals his true character after his house gets burgled by two petty thieves, which, coincidentally, leads him into a bloody war with a Russian crime boss.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2024 · Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Northman

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Civil War

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2021 · Wrath of Man

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · The Covenant

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Avatar: Fire and Ash

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2021 · Raya and the Last Dragon

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Extraction II

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A world-renowned K-Pop girl group balance their lives in the spotlight with their secret identities as demon hunters.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2023 · Gran Turismo

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2020 · Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
